title: Output devices
competency: Identify output devices and explain their functions.

keywords.def: Hardware that gets data out of a computer in human form, e.g. monitor, printer, speaker.
Output shown on a screen, by a monitor or projector.
An output device for high-quality large drawings such as maps and banners.

en.text: Output devices turn computer data into a form people understand: soft copy on a screen (monitor, projector) or hard copy on paper (printer). The monitor is the most used output device; types are CRT, LCD, LED and gas plasma. Printers are impact (dot-matrix, daisy-wheel) or non-impact (ink jet, laser, thermal). A plotter prints large, high-quality drawings like maps. Speakers, headphones and braille readers are output devices too.

screens.title: Screen or paper?
screens.ask: You read a report on the screen, then print it for your teacher. What are the two forms called?
screens.after: Screen = soft copy; paper = hard copy.
